description: This file defines interfaces and declarations related to request pool management in the server, including functions for initializing, resetting, acquiring, and freeing request structures.

methods.name: request_config_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default values for a request configuration based on provided defaults.

methods.name: request_config_reset
methods.description: Resets the request configuration associated with a request.

methods.name: request_init_data
methods.description: Initializes request data structures with connection and server context.

methods.name: request_reset
methods.description: Resets the request structure to a clean state.

methods.name: request_reset_ex
methods.description: Performs an extended reset of the request structure.

methods.name: request_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a request.

methods.name: request_acquire
methods.description: Acquires and returns a request structure for a connection, ensuring non-null return.

methods.name: request_free_data
methods.description: Frees data associated with a request, typically called when cleaning up.

methods.name: request_pool_free
methods.description: Frees the entire request pool, cleaning up all request structures.
